cards.title: 结构
rows: Some surfaces stay cooler in sunlight.
A pale surface reflects more sunlight.
说明机制或发现的用途
A reflective coating may reduce heating.

body.box:
[A] A permeable surface allows water to pass through it into the material below. Ordinary solid paving can direct more rain toward drains.
[B] In a small courtyard experiment, researchers compared water collected below permeable paving with water below solid paving. More water entered the ground beneath the permeable surface.
[C] The result came from one courtyard. Different soils and rainfall patterns would need separate study.
[D] A designer can use permeable paving where the ground beneath it can receive water.

Statement: A comparison measured water passing through two kinds of paving.

body.p: 第一段定义 permeable surface，第二段报告比较的方法和结果。陈述中的 comparison 和 water passing through 对应第二段的实验，答案是第二段。
第三段说明证据的适用范围，第四段讲应用。同一个术语会出现在几段里，匹配时核对陈述问的是哪一种段落功能。

groups.text:
[A] Insulation slows the transfer of heat between spaces at different temperatures.

[B] In a classroom demonstration, students wrapped one container in insulation and left another uncovered. Both initially held water at the same temperature. The wrapped container cooled more slowly.

[C] The demonstration used containers of one size. Its results do not specify the effect of every insulation material.

[D] Insulation is used in buildings to reduce heat transfer through walls.

items.why: 第二段比较 wrapped container 与 uncovered container 的冷却。

items.why: 第四段说明 insulation 用于减少墙体热传递。

groups.text:
[A] Some materials allow heat to move through them more readily than others. A metal spoon placed in a hot drink may become warm at the handle, even though only the other end is in the liquid. Heat passes through the material from the warmer region toward the cooler region. This process, called conduction, can occur in solids without the whole object moving from one place to another. The rate depends on the material and on the conditions under which heat is transferred.

[B] In a classroom investigation, students placed spoons made of different materials in warm water. They measured the temperature near each handle at intervals, keeping the amount and initial temperature of the water the same. The metal handle warmed faster than the wooden handle in their comparison. The students recorded their readings in a table rather than relying on a single observation. The investigation provided an example of different rates of heat transfer under the conditions they selected.

[C] The comparison used spoons of particular shapes and sizes. Their dimensions, as well as the materials, could affect the observations. To examine the role of material more closely, another investigation could use samples with matching dimensions and repeat measurements. The classroom result is therefore evidence about the tested objects, rather than a measurement that directly specifies the rate of transfer for every object made from those materials.

[D] Knowledge of heat transfer is useful when designing the handle of a cooking utensil. A material that transfers heat slowly can help keep a handle cooler than a metal cooking surface. The final temperature also depends on the handle's shape, position and exposure to heat. Designers must consider these features together with strength and cleaning requirements. A material's behavior in a single classroom comparison supplies only one part of the information needed for a practical design.

items.why: 第一段的 Heat passes through the material 和 called conduction 给出定义。

items.stem: Which paragraph reports temperature readings from spoons?
items.why: 第二段的 measured the temperature near each handle 描述具体测量。

items.stem: Which paragraph identifies dimensions as a limitation of the comparison?
items.why: 第三段指出 spoons of particular shapes and sizes 可能影响观察结果。

groups.text:
[A] Rain falling on a field may soak into the ground or flow over the surface. Infiltration is the movement of water from the surface into soil. Its rate varies with conditions including soil structure, the amount of water already present and the surface cover. A surface that accepts water quickly during one event may behave differently when the soil is already wet. Describing infiltration therefore requires attention to the conditions in which it is observed.

[B] A student team investigated two small plots in a school garden. One plot had a layer of plant material on the soil; the other was left uncovered. The team poured the same amount of water onto each plot and recorded how much remained visible on the surface after a fixed interval. Less water remained on the covered plot. The observation described surface water in that comparison; it did not directly measure the depth reached by the water.

[C] Both plots were in the same garden, but their soil could still differ. The students had not measured compaction or water content before adding water. Those differences provide possible explanations alongside the difference in cover. Further comparisons could include several plots and measurements of initial conditions. Repeating the procedure after rain would also show whether the same pattern occurred when the soil began wetter.

[D] Gardeners sometimes add plant material to soil surfaces for several purposes, including protecting exposed soil. A decision to use a covering depends on local conditions and on the needs of the plants. The school comparison can suggest a question for further observation, but it cannot establish the effect of every kind of covering in every garden. Any practical assessment must consider the amount and type of material as well as the soil underneath. Gardeners can also observe how the surface changes after repeated rainfall.

items.stem: Which paragraph reports an experiment comparing covered and uncovered plots?
items.why: 第二段比较 covered plot 与 uncovered plot，并记录表面剩水。

items.stem: Which paragraph defines the movement of water into soil?
items.why: 第一段的 Infiltration is the movement of water from the surface into soil 给出定义。

items.stem: Which paragraph discusses a possible practical use of plant material?
items.why: 第四段的 gardeners add plant material 提到覆盖土壤的用途。
